input: Stitch iron-on patches onto my denim jacket

gold.taskTitle: Stitch iron-on patches onto denim jacket
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to attach iron-on patches to their denim jacket, likely combining the iron-on adhesive with hand or machine stitching for durability.

questions.title: How many patches are you applying to the jacket?
questions.description: Understand the quantity of patches to gauge the scope of the task.

questions.title: Do you already have the patches and jacket ready?
questions.description: Confirm whether materials are on hand or need to be sourced first.

questions.title: Where on the jacket do you want each patch placed?
questions.description: Identify the exact placement locations such as back, sleeves, chest, or collar.

questions.title: Will you stitch by hand or use a sewing machine?
questions.description: Determine the stitching method to tailor the steps and tools needed.

questions.title: What type of stitch do you want around the patches?
questions.description: Find out the preferred stitch style, such as running stitch, whip stitch, or blanket stitch.

questions.title: Do you have thread, needles, and an iron available?
questions.description: Check that all required tools are accessible before starting.

questions.title: When do you need this project completed by?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe to help prioritize and schedule the task.
